response.justification: Bogdan possesses over 15 years of solid software engineering and entrepreneurial experience, meeting the baseline tenure requirements. However, the role demands a Director-level individual contributor with deep, recognized expertise in AI strategy and cloud product development. Bogdan's AI experience appears highly limited and recent, and his background aligns more closely with a hands-on Staff Full-Stack Engineer rather than a strategic advisor for enterprise AI adoption.
strengths: Meets the minimum requirement of 15 years of diverse software engineering experience.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial initiative as the founder of GISCollective.
Strong track record of technical community engagement through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks deep, recognized expertise and a proven track record in AI/ML product development.
Missing Director-level experience in advising strategic enterprise customers on cloud and AI adoption.
Does not hold the preferred advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in an AI-related field.
